donor.use: Corresponding source structure, typed conditional arms and ordinary semantic local names or plain compiler aliases. HoMM1 constants, types and behavior remain retail-backed.

changes.townManager::Open: Read occupying-hero ID directly instead of invoking the Win95 inline accessor. Compound crest multiplication and byte-valued conditional arms restore retail width. Corresponding donor crestFrame/buildId names restore the frame.
changes.townManager::RecruitHero: Player-color product precedes hero class in crest filename; signed-byte conditional arms select strip frame. Local placement remains unresolved.
changes.townManager::BuyBuild: Parenthesized building-minus-first-dwelling term keeps requirement-table displacement in the index calculation. Compound cursor update adds entryWidth before spacing. Local placement remains unresolved.
changes.game::ViewArmy: Conditional narrow-spacing increment; HoMM1 creature flags, Cyrillic capitalization and dialog behavior are preserved. Local placement remains unresolved.
changes.ViewArmyHandler: Blink timer precedes KBTickCount in the animation deadline comparison.
changes.comm_wrt_task: totalWritten precedes node length in the write loop. Corresponding donor comPort/packetNode/callRv names recover retail local placement.
changes.army::GetAdjacentCellIndex: Both wide-direction selections use signed-byte conditional arms, rather than a narrowing cast around an integer conditional.
changes.nb_call_done: Control-block argument precedes the indexed session-block address in comparison.
changes.ResetHeroRVs: The x-minus-hero-x distance precedes y-minus-hero-x. The retail use of hero x in both terms is retained, also present in the donor; this is an evaluation-order correction, not an unrequested behavior fix.
changes.RemoteMain: Network-position term precedes the name-index product in the generated ID sum.
changes.SetGraphicsType: Current graphics type precedes requested type in comparison. Donor buffer/width/fullState/hgt names recover retail frame placement; gConfig.fullScreen remains the canonical member.
changes.combatManager::DrawBackground: Byte-valued parity conditional selects castle frame; local placement remains unresolved.
changes.HandleCastSpell: Current hex precedes saved target in the pointer-refresh comparison.
changes.combatManager::Close: Byte-valued Boolean conditional selects surviving side and avoids a full-register clear absent from retail. Local placement remains unresolved.
changes.philAI::FightEvent: Reward constants precede the gold value in all four floating-point products. Local placement remains unresolved.
changes.Connect: Current time quotient precedes previous time quotient in retry comparison; local placement remains unresolved.
changes.WaitForDirectConnect: Independently verified same time-quotient comparison order; local placement remains unresolved.

retained_diagnostic_findings.0x4ea2c: The guard array starts at EBP-0x14 on both sides. At +0x6f, guards[metadata-2] addresses EBP+ECX*2-0x18. The scalar defenderLoss address at +0x141 is candidate EBP-0x18 versus retail EBP-0xc. A displacement-only local map conflates this scalar with the folded array address. Its warnings remain visible; the function remains non-exact.
retained_diagnostic_findings.0x62630: The gText relocation in a MOV to the local message has instruction-relative offset 3 in candidate versus 6 in retail, where the different frame placement needs a 32-bit displacement. This finding remains visible and the function remains non-exact. No relocation-offset check, comparator, normalization, boundary, enrollment or score was changed.
